reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkAccountAndSync, and unlinking shares clearAccountLink, although transaction downloading repeats existing provider plumbing.

duplication.why: Link validation and clearing are shared, but downloadFintegraTransactions duplicates the authenticated request, error handling, and response normalization of existing downloaders.

placement.why: Provider integration follows existing module boundaries, but assertBankAccountNotLinked mixes validation with the state-changing takeover operation.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the requested linking rules, Fintegra integration, and related tests.

maintainability.why: Shared linking primitives help maintenance, but a mutating assertion and another repeated downloader make responsibilities less clear.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider handlers use the shared validation and linking functions, and both unlink paths use clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing downloadEnableBankingTransactions request/error/normalization sequence using a typed response and direct property access.

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a takeover-versus-rejection branch, expanding an assertion into an operation that clears another account's link.
